title: Credit Memos for Crop Protection Product Returned to the Plant, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Crop protection product that has come back to the plant is credited to the member's crop input account against the delivery it was billed on. The money credited is taken off what the member owes on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts the moment the line posts, and the member sees it on the next statement against that invoice.

The restocking arithmetic the programme's own returns schedule sets out — the invoiced value multiplied by the programme's restocking percentage, with the credit being that value less the charge — is withdrawn together with the pricing clause it belongs to and is not applied to crop protection product worked out this way.

## Writing the credit

The desk writes the credit with `issue_return_credit_6859ca91`. It is a tool the desk holds: it is unlocked first and then called, and one call books a single credit memo line carrying the invoice number and the delivery ticket the product originally left on, so the member and the desk can both see which delivery it answers.

### Parameters

- `account_id` — the internal reference number identifying the crop input account the credit is written on; it is taken from the crop input account record pulled up for this member before the call.
- `invoice_number` — the number of the invoice the returned product was billed on, written in the shape IN- followed by seven digits, for instance IN-4410287, exactly as it stands on the billing record; there is no empty-value form, and it is passed with no spaces and no lower-case letters.
- `delivery_ticket_number` — the ticket the product left the plant on, written in the shape DT- followed by seven digits, for instance DT-2210554, exactly as it stands on the billing record; there is no empty-value form, and it is passed with no spaces and no lower-case letters.
- `product_category` — the input class of the product coming back, one of: `seed`, planting seed of any crop; `dry_fertilizer`, dry granular plant food and bulk blends; `liquid_fertilizer`, solution and suspension plant food pumped from the plant; `crop_protection`, herbicide, insecticide and fungicide; `micronutrients`, chelated and sulphate trace element products; `seed_treatment`, the coatings and inoculants put on seed before it is bagged; `adjuvants`, surfactants, drift agents and other tank additives that carry no nutrient or active of their own.
- `credit_amount` — the money credited to the account on this line, in USD to 2 decimal places, stated as a positive figure and rounded half away from zero to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty-value form and no currency symbol is passed.

### The return

A confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the credit memo's own internal reference, the invoice number the credit was written against, the delivery ticket it answers and the credited money in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the credit memo has posted to the account; no other acknowledgement follows.
